Select IC50 activities against target CHEMBL284 (DPP4). Join target_dictionary (filter target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', organism = 'Homo sapiens') to assays to activities (filter standard_type = 'IC50', standard_units = 'nM'). Inner join molecule_dictionary and compound_structures on activities.molregno, requiring non-null canonical_smiles. Join docs from activities.doc_id = docs.doc_id, requiring at least one of pubmed_id or doi to be non-null. Left join compound_records from activities.record_id = compound_records.record_id to obtain compound_key. Compute pubmed_id_or_doi as COALESCE(pubmed_id, doi). Return DISTINCT rows of: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by all 12 output columns.
